feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 May 2026 7:54am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 21 May 2026 at 7:55am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure area is slow-moving to the west of Ireland, with a moist southerly air stream becoming established in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly South or Southwest 5 or 6 this morning and afternoon, although 3 to 5 in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay. Backing and decreasing Southeast 3 or 4 in all waters this evening, veering South or Southwest 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, although slight in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay, then becoming generally slight or moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Patchy light rain and drizzle, with areas of mist and isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain, drizzle or mist, and very poor in any fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Continuing risk of mist and fog patches, but many areas fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
